clue.text: Commercial lines are damaging …

parts.note: an ad is a commercial
lines of poetry are verse

explanation.surface: Someone complains that advertising copy is doing harm, the ellipsis carrying the thought into the next clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Adverse effects or conditions are harmful ones, so the adjective is a synonym.

clue.text: Group vacated Coventry to establish religious office

parts.note: ABBA is the Swedish pop group

indicators.note: vacated means the town is emptied of its inside letters, keeping only its ends

explanation.surface: A band left a Midlands city to set up a church post.
explanation.definitionFit: An abbacy is the office or jurisdiction of an abbot.

clue.text: Stout caring heart needed in unpleasant surroundings

indicators.note: in puts the middle letters inside the unpleasant word

parts.note: vile means very unpleasant, and here it forms the surroundings

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its middle, here the central pair of caring

explanation.surface: A kind, brave spirit is wanted in a nasty environment.
explanation.definitionFit: Stout in its old sense means strong and brave, close to manly and vigorous.

clue.text: Helping reserve to create means for allocating scarce resources

parts.note: a ration is a portion or helping
to book is to reserve

explanation.surface: A spare portion of food is used to set up a sharing scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: A ration book held the coupons British households used for food under wartime rationing.
explanation.definitionFit: A ration book controlled how much of each scarce food a household could buy.

clue.text: Nigel gets beaten up — he nicked someone's marbles

indicators.note: something beaten up is battered out of shape, so the name's letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A man named Nigel is assaulted after stealing marbles.
explanation.walkthrough: The marbles are the Parthenon sculptures, removed to Britain by Lord Elgin and still disputed.
explanation.definitionFit: Lord Elgin took the Parthenon sculptures from Athens, which Greece regards as theft.

clue.text: … determined to provide late fix

parts.note: the late so-and-so is dead
to fix something in place is to set it

explanation.surface: Carrying on from the previous clue: a resolve to supply a last-minute repair.
explanation.definitionFit: Being dead set on something means being utterly resolved to do it.

clue.text: Let's shape go if you eat too many like this

definitions.text: Let's shape go if you eat too many like this

parts.note: lets go, read with the later go, means drops; the apostrophe is a slip, as the blog notes
a cone is a shape

explanation.surface: A warning that overindulging in these teatime treats ruins your figure.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads 'Lets go' around 'shape': DROPS then CONE. The whole clue also describes the cake, since eating too many lets your shape go.
explanation.definitionFit: A drop scone, or Scotch pancake, is a small griddle cake made from batter dropped on a hot plate.

clue.text: Long to be a revolutionary

parts.note: Che Guevara, the Argentine revolutionary

explanation.surface: Someone yearns to become a rebel.
explanation.definitionFit: To ache for something is to yearn or long for it.

clue.text: Left leader in a fight

parts.note: a boxer who leads with the left hand

explanation.walkthrough: It reads like a left-wing politician heading a campaign, but it is a boxer whose lead hand is the left.
explanation.definitionFit: A southpaw is a left-handed boxer who stands with the right foot forward and jabs with the left.

clue.text: Half of find submerged in ancient city gives diver problem

indicators.note: the half word is sunk inside the city name

parts.note: Thebes, the ancient city in Egypt or Greece

indicators.note: half of here keeps the back half of the word find, its last two letters

explanation.surface: An underwater discovery in a lost city causes trouble for a diver.
explanation.definitionFit: The bends is decompression sickness, which strikes divers who surface too quickly.

clue.text: Reservation about navy being toasted

indicators.note: the word for a reservation goes round, about, the navy letters

parts.note: a 'but' is an objection or reservation, as in 'no ifs or buts'
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: A doubt is raised about sailors who have been drinking toasts, or getting sunburnt.
explanation.definitionFit: Bread that has been toasted is browned, or slightly burned, by heat.

clue.text: Complain about health group creating a drug production facility

indicators.note: the complaint word wraps around, about, the health body

parts.note: to grouse is to grumble or complain
WHO is the World Health Organization

explanation.surface: Someone moans about a medical body setting up a pharmaceutical plant.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'drug' is cannabis, not medicine: a grow house is a building converted to raise the plants indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: A grow house is a property used to cultivate illegal cannabis plants under lamps.

clue.text: College let head show some inexperience

parts.note: to let is to allow
a ness is a headland, a head jutting into the sea, as in Loch Ness's neighbour names

explanation.surface: A college permits its principal to display some naivety.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head' looks like the college head, but it is a geographic headland.
explanation.definitionFit: Callowness is the immaturity of someone young and untested, which is a lack of experience.

clue.text: It reveals excitement as we pick up ambassador

indicators.note: the word we picks up, takes in, the ambassador's letters

parts.note: taken as written
HE, His Excellency, is the title of an ambassador

explanation.surface: We thrill to collecting a diplomat from the airport.
explanation.definitionFit: Whee is an exclamation of delight, the cry of someone on a ride.

clue.text: It's peculiar, butler says, in a complicated sort of way

definitions.text: in a complicated sort of way

indicators.note: peculiar means odd, so the letters of the phrase come out in an odd order

explanation.surface: A manservant remarks on something odd in a convoluted manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Abstrusely means in an obscure way that is hard to understand.

clue.text: Junior executive position often advertised in the back window

definitions.text: often advertised in the back window

parts.note: a baby is the most junior of a family
an executive's place is on the board of directors

explanation.surface: It reads as a job advert for a trainee manager.
explanation.definitionFit: Baby on Board is the sign drivers stick in a rear car window to warn others an infant is travelling.

clue.text: Distribute green bins — they're very green

indicators.note: to distribute is to spread out, so the letters are dealt into a new order

explanation.surface: An instruction to hand out recycling bins to the most eco-minded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'green' first means eco-friendly bins, then inexperienced.
explanation.definitionFit: Green means inexperienced, and beginners are novices with little experience.

clue.text: Links up over wire to capture unpleasant insect

indicators.note: in a down answer, the first piece sits over the next
in a down clue, up means the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: to knit is to link or join together
to bug is to wire a place to capture conversations

explanation.surface: Wires are joined above a listening device to trap a nasty creature.
explanation.definitionFit: The stink bug is a shield bug that releases a foul smell when disturbed.

clue.text: It starts breaking up communication in the US

definitions.text: It starts breaking up communication in the US

parts.words: It starts breaking up communication in the US
parts.note: the opening words of a letter ending a relationship, a term of American origin

explanation.walkthrough: The 'communication' is a letter, and 'It starts' is literal: the letter starts with these words.
explanation.definitionFit: A Dear John letter is one in which a partner ends a relationship, a term from American wartime use.

clue.text: Goethe's gift wasted? You really don't know, not having it

definitions.text: You really don't know, not having it

indicators.note: letters that are wasted have been wrecked, so the poet's gift is rearranged

explanation.surface: A rhetorical question asking whether the German poet's talent was squandered.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the idiom 'not have the foggiest', meaning to have no idea at all.
explanation.definitionFit: Not having the foggiest (idea) is an idiom for being completely clueless.

clue.text: Coastal resort that has some edge in India

parts.note: a rim is an edge
I is India in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A seaside town said to have a boundary inside India.
explanation.definitionFit: Rimini is an Italian holiday town on the Adriatic coast.

clue.text: Shocked as top lawyer suffers with tension

parts.note: AG, the Attorney General, is a government's chief lawyer and so the top one
to have an illness is to suffer it
T is the physics symbol for tension

explanation.surface: Appalled, as a senior barrister endures stress.
explanation.definitionFit: Aghast means filled with horror or amazement.

clue.text: Techie type emerging when the power died finally

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of each of the four words before it

explanation.surface: A computer expert appears from the dark after a power cut.
explanation.definitionFit: A nerd is a stereotyped obsessive enthusiast, especially of computers and technology.

clue.text: US gunman is surprisingly modest

indicators.note: surprisingly signals that these letters turn up in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: An American gunfighter turns out to be a humble type.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone unassuming does not push themselves forward, a synonym for being humble.

clue.text: Put nuts back, having no time when night's over

indicators.note: having no takes out each occurrence of the time letter
back means the two words are read from right to left

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time, removed twice here

explanation.surface: Return the nuts quickly before dawn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns PUT NUTS into STUNTUP; 'having no time' strips both Ts.
explanation.definitionFit: Sunup is sunrise, the moment night ends.

clue.text: Supplements found in coating of acid drops

indicators.note: the coating of a word is its outside, so first and last letters of each

explanation.surface: Vitamins are discovered in the shell of sour sweets.
explanation.walkthrough: Acid drops are boiled sweets with a sour coating.
explanation.definitionFit: To add is to supplement, so adds means supplements as a verb.

clue.text: Head onto secondary route — it's showing green

parts.note: a B road is a secondary road in Britain, below an A road
bean is slang for the head

explanation.surface: A driver turns on to a minor road as the traffic light shows green.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain, B roads are minor routes ranked below A roads.
explanation.definitionFit: The broad bean is a green vegetable, so it shows green on the plate.

clue.text: Local loses name when backing musical

indicators.note: backing means the shortened word is read from end to start
loses says the name letter drops out of the local word

parts.note: a native is a local of a place

explanation.surface: A resident, losing their name, supports a stage show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loses' takes N from NATIVE to leave ATIVE, and 'backing' turns that round.
explanation.definitionFit: Evita is the Lloyd Webber and Rice stage musical about Eva Perón.

clue.text: Book is on what make us who we are

indicators.note: in an across answer, is placed on, after, the genes word

parts.words: what make us who we are
parts.note: genes carry the inherited instructions that shape each person
taken as written

explanation.surface: A volume is about the things that form our identity.
explanation.definitionFit: Genesis is the first book of the Bible.

clue.text: Move DIY into section that shows profit

indicators.note: into puts the reworked letters inside the section word

parts.note: a part is a section

indicators.note: move says to shift the letters of DIY into another order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Shift the home-improvement department into the profitable part of the store.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a shop reorganisation; 'that shows profit' is a fair gloss because pay dirt is ore-bearing ground worth working.
explanation.definitionFit: Pay dirt is ground rich enough in ore to be worth mining, hence any profitable find.
